question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Slip your mind

options.text: Can’t think of anything to say
Think about something for a short time

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Forget about something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Slip your mind"** means to forget about something. (भूल जाना)

 
 
• **Example: **I'm sorry I didn't call you back, it completely slipped my mind.
 
 
 
• **"Forget about something"** refers to failing to remember something that one was supposed to do. (किसी चीज़ को भूल जाना)
 
 
• **Example: **She forgot about the meeting and missed it entirely.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Forget about something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Immediately think of something** (तुरंत किसी चीज़ के बारे में सोचना):

 
 
• **Example:** When I saw the picture, I immediately thought of our trip to Paris.
 
 
 
• **Can't think of anything to say** (कहने के लिए कुछ भी नहीं सोच पाना):
 
 
• **Example:** When he asked me that question, I couldn't think of anything to say.
 
 
 
• **Think about something for a short time** (थोड़े समय के लिए किसी चीज़ के बारे में सोचना):
 
 
• **Example:** I thought about the proposal for a short time before making a decision.
